course.title: Linear Integrated Circuits and Digital Systems

content.value:
Consider a logic circuit with three inputs A, B and C. Output F is 1 (high) for the 12   
following conditions:   
i) A & C are false but B is true   
ii) B & C are false but A is true   
iii) A & C are true but B is false   
iv) A & B are true but C is false   
v) A, B & C are true.   
Minimize the function Y using Boolean algebra.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
